## `abatements.csv`

One row per data center tax abatement award approved by the GOED board under NRS 360.754.

Primary key: `id`

| Column | Type | Required | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `slug` | yes |  | Stable identifier. Never reuse or renumber. |
| `fiscal_year` | `year` | yes |  | Nevada fiscal year of board approval. |
| `approved_date` | `yearmonth` | yes |  | Month the GOED board approved the award. |
| `program` | enum: `nrs-360-754`, `pre-2015-standard` | yes |  | Statutory program the award was made under. |
| `entity_name` | `string` | yes |  | Legal applicant entity, as verified against the most authoritative source. |
| `company_id` | ref → `companies.company_id` | yes |  | Operator this entity belongs to. |
| `county` | enum: `Carson City`, `Churchill`, `Clark`, `Douglas`, `Elko`, `Esmeralda`, `Eureka`, `Humboldt`, `Lander`, `Lincoln`, `Lyon`, `Mineral`, `Nye`, `Pershing`, `Storey`, `Washoe`, `White Pine` | yes |  | Nevada county of the facility. |
| `award_type` | enum: `new`, `expansion` | yes |  | New facility or expansion of an existing one. |
| `capital_investment_usd` | `money` |  | USD | Capital investment the applicant committed to over five years. |
| `jobs_promised` | `int` |  |  | Full-time Nevada-resident jobs committed within five years. |
| `avg_wage_promised_usd` | `decimal` |  | USD/hour | Average hourly wage the applicant committed to. |
| `statutory_wage_usd` | `decimal` |  | USD/hour | Statewide average wage the applicant had to meet, where the source states it. |
| `sut_abatement_usd` | `money` |  | USD | Approved partial sales and use tax abatement. |
| `sut_years` | `int` |  |  | Term of the sales and use tax abatement. |
| `personal_property_abatement_usd` | `money` |  | USD | Approved partial personal property tax abatement. |
| `pp_years` | `int` |  |  | Term of the personal property tax abatement. |
| `total_abatement_reported_usd` | `money` |  | USD | Total abatement as published, where a source gives a total directly. |
| `status` | enum: `active`, `withdrawn`, `expired`, `rescinded` | yes |  | Current state of the award. |
| `verification` | enum: `primary`, `secondary`, `unverified` | yes |  | Strength of the best available source. |
| `primary_source_id` | ref → `sources.source_id` | yes |  | Best source for this row. |
| `source_page` | `string` |  |  | Page number within the source document. |
| `notes` | `text` |  |  | Caveats and provenance detail. |

| Column | Type | Required | Unit | Description |
